_comment: Everything YOU supply, secrets included. Lives at ~/.config/rfc-agent/config.json (chmod 600), never inside the plugin. Values marked 'team' are the same for everyone on your team — ask a teammate for them. Anything here overrides the plugin's config.harness.json, which lists the harness's own settings.

ATLASSIAN._comment: Team. Your Atlassian site; Scope opens Confluence/Jira through it. Env ATLASSIAN_SITE wins.

LANGFUSE._comment: HOST is the team's Langfuse; the keys are yours.
LANGFUSE._ENVIRONMENT_note: Optional. Langfuse environment for this machine's runs (e.g. 'eval' on a benchmark box) — partitions eval traffic from operator runs. Empty = Langfuse default. The LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENVIRONMENT env var wins (smokes set it).

mcpServers._fleetlens_note: The context layer: team URL + your token. Scope finds the repos a PRD touches with it; Investigate and Review trace endpoints and callers across repos. Keep the name 'fleetlens'. Needs network reachability (VPN if internal).
mcpServers._bitbucket_note: Optional. Scope's fallback for reading the service inventory (SERVICES_MAP) when that repo is not checked out locally. Workspace is the team's; credentials and path are yours.

SERVICES_MAP._comment: Team. Where your repo -> deployed-service inventory lives (an Ansible group_vars file). Leave REPO empty if you have none: Scope then relies on STEERING.REPO_ALIASES.

SCOPE._SURFACES_note: Team. Your product surfaces -> the repos that build them. Scope matches the PRD against `what` and proposes those repos. A surface with no repos is still reported.

customer_web.what: customer website and mobile web: storefront, product pages, cart, checkout

_REPOS_EXCLUDE_note: Team. Repos Scope never offers, comma list (e.g. an evals repo that holds model answers).

OBS._comment: Trace identity: OBS.USER_ID (explicit — CI/shared boxes) > git config user.email (canonical org identity, the default) > $USER. Never the shared Claude account.

AGENT._comment: Optional — leave out what you don't need. CLAUDE_BIN: the claude binary (default `claude`). CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_FILE: a separate Claude login for the agents (empty = your normal login). Any harness value from config.harness.json can be overridden here too.
AGENT._EXTRA_DISALLOWED_TOOLS_note: Comma-separated tool/server patterns denied in every harness stage, appended to each stage's own disallowed list — e.g. 'mcp__claude_ai_Canva' to keep a claude.ai connector your account has away from the agents. Deny wins over allow.
